text.workline.hearthford.title: The Houses Above the Race
text.workline.hearthford.branch.s: Raise dry stores in the mill loft
text.workline.greywash.title: The Light without a Toll
text.workline.greywash.branch.l: Light a public warning above the dunes
text.workline.greywash.branch.q: Keep a screened signal for accountable salvage
text.workline.greenwold.title: Root and Ash
text.workline.greenwold.branch.w: Dampen the root reserve without cutting trees
text.workline.whitecairn.title: The Load Below the Bell
text.workline.whitecairn.branch.b: Brace the lower counterweight and keep the haul
text.workline.whitecairn.branch.r: Release the burden and accept a fallen face
text.workline.requirement.crowded: the worksite is already crowded with altered material; clear it before this work
text.workline.requirement.hearthford.timber: one physical timber lot for the framing
text.workline.requirement.greywash.oil: two lamp-oil measures for a public light; one for a screened signal
text.workline.requirement.greenwold.cutting: a cutting weapon, repair tools or Lever Craft
text.workline.requirement.greenwold.brine: bring a brine pot, expose actual water here, or operate the burn water control
text.workline.requirement.whitecairn.ironwork: one physical ironwork lot for the lower clamp
text.workline.requirement.whitecairn.release: a cutting or levering implement; the warned neighbouring support will fall
text.workline.option.near_witness: speak beside the local secondary contact
text.workline.option.copy.label: Copy the surviving site marks{replacement}
text.workline.option.copy.requirement: survey the coffer; replacement after loss costs one credit (at most three copies)
text.workline.option.field.label: Perform the disclosed field work
text.workline.option.field.requirement: carry the site evidence to the field position; {requirement}
text.workline.option.settle_public.label: Give the working result to the local commons
text.workline.option.settle_private.label: Hold the result under Jomon's paid obligation
text.workline.option.settle.requirement: return to the named secondary witness
text.workline.option.abandon.label: Abandon this undertaking and record its failure
text.workline.option.abandon.requirement: return to the witness to accept the consequence
text.workline.line.none: No second undertaking is offered here.
text.workline.line.carry: Carry {evidence}; an existing copy must be recovered, not duplicated.
text.workline.line.survey_help: F then W copies the outside marks. Opening the coffer too is optional: one evidence credit at settlement.
text.workline.line.resolution: Physical work is recorded. Return to the named witness to decide its ownership.
text.workline.line.general: F then W: local work; Z: full ledger. Inspection is free; confirmed work advances time.
text.workline.line.available: Both approaches remain optional. Escape declines for now without changing the account.
text.workline.line.evidence: Evidence is a physical 1x2 pack item: it may be dropped, stolen or left on a defeated courier.
text.workline.line.beacon: FACT: Dune light {status}; local charcoal maintains it after two initial days. {account}
text.workline.guard.reason: a witnessed undertaking would change this worker's material claim
text.workline.guard.notice: {actor} approaches the worksite on an assigned watch. Evade the patrol or show the survey with V.
text.workline.survey.whitecairn: The rubbing identifies cracked lower supports: F inspection shows their actual weakened condition below the bell.
text.workline.survey.result: The {evidence} is {copy_state}. Its testimony supports this undertaking, not every hostile claim.
text.workline.survey.ground: left physically at the marked survey coffer; use I to pack it
text.workline.result.hearthford.h: Timber raises the watch-house approach; flooded ground becomes a firm shared route.
text.workline.result.hearthford.s: The loft receives new supports and two counted grain lots; storage survives where the lower houses do not improve.
text.workline.result.greywash.l: The dune light gives two more sight paces within twenty paces of its mast for two days. After that, the local workers consume one charcoal lot per day to keep it lit; shortages darken it.
text.workline.result.greywash.q: A screened smoke signal obscures the wreck approach and pays two salvage credits; the broad public sightline is not improved.
text.workline.result.greenwold.c: The narrow cut opens a ground-level firebreak and longer sightline; concealment and standing timber are sacrificed.
text.workline.result.greenwold.w: Water is held in the root reserve; local smoke clears while woodland concealment stays intact.
text.workline.result.whitecairn.b: A physical iron clamp steadies the lower support and keeps the haul's material claim alive.
text.workline.result.whitecairn.r: The counterweight is released. Its neighbouring support will fall after three more beats; leave the marked place. Two lime lots are forfeited.
text.workline.settle.public: Local commons: the work remains in place, local trust rises and connected cargo routes ease; Jomon takes no fee.
text.workline.settle.private: Household surety: three credits now, two recorded obligations and higher local demand; the physical work remains, but route risk does not ease.
text.workline.settle.actor_intent: accepts the named witness's public working settlement
text.workline.settle.optional: Opening the optional coffer earned one evidence credit.
text.workline.resolve.unavailable: That undertaking action is not available.
text.workline.open.mark: {title}: the {evidence} can be copied beside this coffer.
text.workline.open.message: {title} opens under {witness}'s witness. Survey the marked coffer; F then W exposes the work and costs.
text.workline.abandon: The undertaking is abandoned; the witness records a broken promise and releases the household from its terms.
text.workline.beacon.lit: lit until the next work day
text.workline.beacon.dark: dark until charcoal reaches the local market
text.workline.ui.material_entry: Local undertaking: evidence and field work
text.workline.item.evidence.description: Site testimony for {title}; supports field work and terms with its assigned guard. Recover after loss, or pay for a replacement copy at the survey site.
